* Build and maintain SharePoint Online sites, lists, libraries, forms, and permission structures.

As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
  
  
**General Description Of Role**
About the Role
  
  
As a DevOps Engineer within the Assessment Solutions business, you will own the delivery infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform operations that keep the Aon Assessment Platform running reliably at scale. The Aon Assessment Platform is the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments used by millions of participants worldwide — the infrastructure you build and maintain is what makes that scale possible.
  
  
You will work across multiple engineering squads (Germany and India), ensuring that every team has fast, reliable, and secure delivery pipelines, and that the platform's cloud infrastructure is observable, cost-efficient, and resilient. You are a hands-on practitioner: writing Terraform, maintaining Kubernetes configurations, building pipeline templates, and driving the automation that reduces toil and increases engineering throughput.
  
  
Above all, this role requires strong systems thinking. Our platform is deeply interconnected, and infrastructure decisions have wide downstream effects on reliability, security, and delivery speed. You must be able to reason about those effects and design infrastructure that the whole engineering group can depend on.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
CI/CD Pipeline Engineering
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that serve multiple engineering squads building on different release cadences.
* Own pipeline templates and shared workflow components — ensuring consistent, reusable patterns across squads rather than per-team divergence.
* Integrate automated testing (unit, integration, API spec validation) into pipelines so quality gates run at the right point in every delivery workflow.
* Maintain and improve build performance — reducing pipeline duration and queue times to keep squad delivery velocity high.
* Enforce API governance in delivery: pipelines validate implementations against OpenAPI specifications before merge and deployment.

Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes
  
  

* Own the platform's Azure infrastructure: AKS clusters, networking, storage, identity, and supporting services — defined and managed as code using Terraform.
* Manage Kubernetes workloads across environments (development, staging, production): deployments, resource allocation, autoscaling, and health management.
* Design and maintain environment promotion workflows that give squads reliable, consistent progression from development through to production.
* Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls: network policies, managed identities, secret management (Azure Key Vault), and RBAC.
* Monitor infrastructure costs and drive efficiency improvements — right-sizing resources, identifying waste, and contributing to cloud spend targets.

Observability & Reliability
  
  

* Build and maintain observability tooling across the platform: metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or equivalent).
* Define and implement SLI/SLO frameworks in collaboration with Engineering Team Leads and Solution Architects, ensuring the platform can demonstrate reliability against defined targets.
* Own incident response for infrastructure-layer events: diagnosing, communicating, and resolving outages with clear post-incident reviews and preventive actions.
* Drive reliability improvements — identifying single points of failure, improving resilience patterns, and reducing mean time to recovery.

Engineering Enablement & Standards
  
  

* Work closely with Solution Architects and Engineering Team Leads to ensure application architecture is deployable, observable, and operable — raising infrastructure requirements early in the design process, not after delivery.
* Define and maintain infrastructure-as-code standards: Terraform module structure, naming conventions, state management, and code review practices.
* Build internal documentation and runbooks that give squads and support teams the operational knowledge they need to work independently.
* Evaluate and introduce tooling improvements that raise engineering throughput and platform quality — with a pragmatic eye for adoption, not novelty.

AI-Augmented Engineering
  
  

* Use AI tools in your day-to-day work — for infrastructure design, pipeline authoring, incident investigation, and documentation — and apply them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.
* Identify where AI-assisted tooling can reduce toil, accelerate root cause analysis, and improve infrastructure quality.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–6 years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering experience on a large-scale SaaS or enterprise platform.
* Strong, production-proven experience with Azure: AKS, Azure DevOps, Azure Container Registry, Azure Key Vault, networking, and managed identities.
* Deep hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code: module design, state management, and code review practices at team scale.
* Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps across multiple squads or products.
* Solid Kubernetes expertise: workload management, autoscaling, networking, and operational troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure security: network policies, RBAC, secret management, and least-privilege access design.
* Experience with observability tooling and a practical understanding of SLI/SLO/SLA frameworks.
* Excellent analytical and systems thinking — able to reason about the downstream infrastructure impact of application architecture decisions.
* Strong communication skills: able to explain infrastructure constraints and tradeoffs clearly to engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.
* Day-to-day use of AI tools in infrastructure and engineering work. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with messaging and mediation frameworks relevant to the platform (e.g., Wolverine, Azure Service Bus).
* Familiarity with API governance tooling — integrating OpenAPI spec validation into pipelines.
* Experience with contract testing or consumer-driven contract frameworks in a microservices context.
* Exposure to FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation at meaningful scale.
* Experience supporting globally distributed engineering teams working across multiple time zones.
* Familiarity with .NET / ASP.NET Core application deployment patterns at the infrastructure level.

* Oversee the FPGA validation and pre-silicon emulation strategy, ensuring robust verification of the entire system and seamless interface between hardware and software.
* Support the overall verification strategy in collaboration with the verification team, defining success criteria, and ensuring comprehensive functional coverage to deliver first-pass silicon success.

title: VP - FPGA
description:
**Position - Vice President of FPGA & HW Engineering**

**Role Summary**

**Title:**
Vice President of Engineering

**Location:**
Gurugram / Bangalore, India (Hybrid / On-site)

**Reporting To:**
Chief Operating Officer

**Organization Size:**
~150 FPGA/Hardware Engineers (Multi-site)

We seek a
**technical engineering leader**
to drive product innovation, architectural excellence, and execution discipline across our FPGA-based hardware platforms. This is a
**pure engineering leadership role**
— you will define products, architect solutions, lead technical teams, and deliver world-class FPGA platforms on budget and on schedule.

**Core Mandate**

The Vice President of Engineering is accountable for:

* **Product Definition:**
  Define technical specifications, system architecture, and feature roadmaps for proprietary FPGA platforms
* **Engineering Execution:**
  Deliver products from concept through production on defined timelines and NRE budgets
* **Technical Innovation:**
  Drive product-level innovation in FPGA architectures, AI/ML acceleration, and advanced interfaces
* **Team Leadership:**
  Build, mentor, and scale a 150-person engineering organization across Gurugram and Bangalore

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Definition & Technical Leadership**

**System Architecture & Product Vision**

Define end-to-end architecture for FPGA-based platforms — from silicon selection and IP strategy to board design, firmware, and system validation. Translate market requirements into technical specifications and multi-year product roadmaps.

**Innovation Leadership**

Drive product-level innovation in:

* Heterogeneous FPGA architectures (AMD Versal, Altera Agilex)
* Deterministic AI/ML inference for edge computing
* High-speed interfaces (PCIe Gen6/7, CXL, 200G/400G/800G Ethernet, PQC, etc.)

**Technical Decision Authority**

Own all major technical decisions: FPGA device selection, IP vs. custom RTL trade-offs, verification strategy, toolchain selection, and design methodology standards.

**2. Engineering Execution & Delivery**

**End-to-End Product Delivery**

Lead cross-functional engineering teams through full product lifecycle:

* RTL design, synthesis, place & route, timing closure
* Board design (high-speed digital, power integrity, thermal)
* Firmware and embedded software
* System integration and performance validation
* Certification and compliance

**Execution Discipline**

Establish and enforce engineering rigor: design reviews, verification closure (SystemVerilog/UVM), release gates, and post-silicon validation protocols. Manage NRE budgets and ensure predictable delivery against committed schedules.

**Risk Management**

Identify and mitigate technical risks early: silicon errata workarounds, timing closure challenges, signal integrity issues, thermal constraints, and supply chain dependencies.

**3. Organization Building & Leadership**

**Multi-Site Engineering Leadership**

Unify Gurugram and Bangalore engineering teams under common design methodologies, verification frameworks, and release processes. Build a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and accountability.

**Talent Development**

Build and mentor the next generation of technical leaders. Create clear technical career paths from Senior Engineer through Principal/Fellow levels.

**Retention & Culture**

Maintain ≥90% retention of Senior Staff+ talent through technical mentorship, challenging problems, IP co-ownership, and a culture that values deep technical expertise. Attract top FPGA talent from across India.

**Team Scaling**

Scale the engineering organization from 150 to 200+ engineers over 24 months while maintaining quality, velocity, and culture.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Master's or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline
* **Experience:**
  18+ years in FPGA/hardware engineering, including 8+ years leading engineering teams of 100+ engineers
* **Product Delivery Track Record:**
  Must have
  **led engineering teams**
  that delivered ≥2 FPGA-based products from architecture through volume production (>500 units shipped). Pure design services or consulting experience does not qualify.

**Technical Expertise — Core Requirements**

**FPGA Mastery**

* Deep expertise with AMD/Xilinx (Versal, UltraScale+) and/or Intel/Altera (Agilex, Stratix) device families
* Advanced proficiency with Vivado, Vitis, Quartus, and High-Level Synthesis (HLS)
* Hands-on experience with complex FPGA architectures: AI Engines, DSP slices, high-speed transceivers, DDR controllers

**AI/ML on FPGA**

* Practical experience deploying AI/ML inference on FPGAs (Vitis AI, Versal DPU, or custom accelerators)
* Understanding of model quantization, DPU vs custom RTL trade-offs, and deterministic latency optimization
* Experience with vision processing, sensor fusion, or real-time packet processing workloads

**High-Speed Digital Design**

* Proven delivery of platforms with PCIe Gen4/5, 100G+ Ethernet, or RF-ADC/DAC
* Signal integrity, timing closure, and power integrity at advanced nodes

**Verification & Validation**

* Strong command of SystemVerilog/UVM, constrained-random verification, and coverage-driven methodologies
* Experience with HW/SE co-verification, emulation platforms, and FPGA prototyping

**Board-Level Systems**

* Understanding of complete system design: power architecture, thermal management, PCB layout constraints for high-speed signals
* Experience with ruggedized or embedded systems for defense/aerospace applications

**Leadership Competencies**

**Technical Leadership at Scale**

* Proven ability to lead 100+ engineer organizations across multiple sites in India
* Experience unifying distributed teams under common methodologies & quality standards
* Track record of mentoring and developing senior technical leaders

**Execution Excellence**

* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex hardware products on time and within budget
